topic: Unlocking Planar Graphs: Euler's Formula and Duality

sections.title: Prerequisites & Definitions
lecture_lines: Vertices, edges, and faces are fundamental components.
Visualize a simple triangular planar graph.
animations: Create three points in white (#FFFFFF) for vertices.
Connect vertices with lines in cyan (#00FFFF) for edges.
Highlight the resulting face in translucent magenta (#FF00FF).

sections.title: Euler’s Characteristic Formula
lecture_lines: Euler's formula states V minus E plus F equals 2.
This constant invariant holds for connected planar graphs.
A square with a diagonal validates the formula.
animations: Display V - E + F = 2 in yellow (#FFFF00).
Draw [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/square.svg] with a diagonal in green (#00FF00).
Highlight counts V=4, E=5, F=3 in red (#FF0000).

sections.title: The Concept of Dual Graphs
lecture_lines: Dual graphs transform faces into new vertices.
Connect vertices if their faces share an edge.
Hexagonal honeybee grids form triangular dual lattices.
animations: Place nodes in centers of existing faces in red (#FF0000) and represent each node as a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/honeybee.svg].
Draw dotted yellow (#FFFF00) lines between these centers to connect the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/honeybee.svg] icons.
Show the transformation of the dual grid clearly while maintaining the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/honeybee.svg] positions.

sections.title: Duality Mechanics & Symmetry
lecture_lines: Dual graphs flip vertices and faces.
Edges remain constant in dual transformations.
Duality is a beautiful reciprocal relationship.
animations: Flash V_dual = F_original in green (#00FF00) using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].
Draw mapping from original edges to dual edges.
Show the dual of a square as a diamond.

sections.title: Application & Wrap-up
lecture_lines: Duality helps solve complex routing problems.
Shifting from nodes to regions optimizes paths.
Use dual graphs for efficient network design.
animations: Show a grid layout representing a warehouse using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/warehouse.svg] in cyan (#00FFFF).
Trace a path through the dual graph in yellow (#FFFF00).
Display 'Optimized' text in white (#FFFFFF) at the end.
